joiin-calc.a: What does it cost to consolidate ten companies?
joiin-calc.b: Consolidating two, ten or fifty companies: what does it cost?

body: Our free calculator compares Joiin, Fathom and Spotlight Reporting by company count.

joiin-template.a: Consolidate three companies in Excel, for free.
joiin-template.b: A free Excel consolidation template, for up to three companies.
joiin-template.c: Month-end consolidation in Excel? Here's a free template.
body: Paste in up to three trial balances from Xero, QuickBooks, Sage or MYOB.
You get a consolidated P and L and balance sheet.
The eliminations sheet removes intercompany sales, fees and balances, and every check cell shows if it ties out.
One limit: no foreign currency, so translate overseas subsidiaries first. Link in bio.
